thread:
maria: Heads-up — proposing a small UX change: surface SLO thresholds & notification routing on the route card in Console. Need API contract + telemetry plan before we ship.
ben: 👍 can you sketch the contract? also thinking about noisy tenants — how does suppression work?
kai: Uploaded a quick mock: https://redwood.internal/figma/proto-slo-card (private)
trina: main concern is noise. if we expose thresholds by default we'll get extra alerts. We need sane defaults: soft thresholds + sample/quiet windows.
maria: Agreed. Proposal: show effective threshold + an indicator when tenant-level quieting or sampling is active. Also allow quick edit to override per-route.
ben: For API, I propose notify_policy.v2 that decouples routing from noise controls. Minimal payload example:
```json
{ "route_id": "r-123", "slo": { "threshold_pct": 99.5, "window_secs": 300 }, "notify_policy": { "channels": ["pagerduty", "email"], "backoff_secs": 180, "sample_rate": 0.01, "quiet_window_secs": 600 } }
```
kai: That looks okay. UI needs to surface which fields are tenant-managed vs route-overridable. We should include a provenance flag in the API like `provenance: ["tenant_policy"]` so client can show a badge.
trina: +1. For telemetry, we must record: effective_threshold, pre-suppression_count, post-suppression_count, sample_rate_used, and reason_code when we suppress. Otherwise we won't be able to debug.
maria: Good call. Add `suppress_reason` enum to events: NOISY_TENANT, QUIET_WINDOW, RATE_LIMIT, MANUAL_OVERRIDE.
ben: Rollout plan: feature-flag the UI; server returns new fields under `notify_policy_v2` with fallback to `notify_policy`. Start with read-only in Canary for 10% tenants, run a week, check increased alert volume metric.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: release/slo-card-v2 -> canary group 10% at 2026-03-28T03:00:00Z. CI checks: unit tests + telemetry metrics gating.
maria: Tests: add unit for API schema validation, end-to-end that verifies suppressed alerts don't generate notifications, and a telemetry smoke test that logs pre/post counts.
ben: I'll draft an RFC for the API changes + telemetry schema. Ping me if you want to pair on the gating queries.
kai: I'll update mock and add the badge states for provenance & suppressed counts.
trina: Thanks — once RFC is up we'll schedule a brief sync. :thumbsup:
